title: Brush Collision Free Suggestions
description: Complete puzzle3d brush tool: engagement suggestions and commits must be collision-free. Random compatible order, probe AABB vs scene meshes (exclude host), empty placement when none free.
summary: Fixed empty brush suggestions at high tolerance (e.g. tambour at slider 100) when many collision-free placements exist. Root cause: collision probe skipped all candidates while catalog GLBs were not in the styled mesh pool, then cleared preview so meshes never loaded. BrushSession now bootstraps a shuffled compatible preview when probe returns unknownPending, preloads unique catalog mesh URLs into the styled pool, and reconciles collision-free candidates once GLBs load. Engagement shows a probing status instead of false "no placement" during load. Added brushMeshUrlsForCompatibleCandidates helper and tests (238 passing).
